title: Speed Optimization and SEO
menuDescription: Find slow pages and technical problems that affect search indexing.
summary: Review page speed and technical SEO, then prioritize fixes using your site's data.

overview.title: Find the causes of slow pages and indexing issues.
paragraphs: We investigate loading behavior and indexing reports on your priority pages. That includes large assets, third-party scripts, and page metadata.
You get a list of fixes ordered by impact and effort. We agree on what to measure before making changes and compare the results afterward.

banner.title: Which pages are giving you trouble?
banner.description: Share the URLs and any Search Console or performance reports you have.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee search rankings?
faqs.answer: No. Rankings depend on competition, content, authority, technical quality, and search-system changes. We focus on measurable technical improvements and clear search fundamentals.

faqs.question: Which data is useful for an audit?
faqs.answer: Search Console, analytics, performance monitoring, crawl data, release history, and the business priority of key pages all help us make better recommendations.

faqs.question: Do we need a full redesign to improve speed?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Many performance issues can be addressed through targeted changes to assets, rendering, templates, code delivery, and third-party scripts.

faqs.question: Do you also write SEO content?
faqs.answer: Our focus is the technical and product foundation. We can help define page intent, structure, and measurement, then collaborate with your internal or specialist content team.

faqs.question: How do you measure improvement?
faqs.answer: The measurement plan is agreed before changes. Depending on the goal, it may include Core Web Vitals, crawl and indexing signals, search visibility, qualified visits, and conversion behavior.
